data.title: Manchester City XI vs Liverpool – Predicted lineup and team news - Yahoo Sports
data.content: # Manchester City XI vs Liverpool – Predicted lineup and team news. **Manchester City visit Liverpool on Sunday afternoon as Premier League leaders with a perfect record, in their first match since being found guilty of breaching the league's financial rules.**. The club have lodged an appeal and continue to deny wrongdoing, and Enzo Maresca said at his press conference that he has complete trust in the club. ## Manchester City team news. Erling Haaland, who has five league goals this season, is fit to lead the line after limping off for Norway against Portugal, and Maresca said he is "good" after a few days of rest in Marbella. Maresca may stick with the back four that conceded three against Sunderland, with Matheus Nunes, Marc Guehi, Ruben Dias and Gvardiol in front of Gianluigi Donnarumma. ## Manchester City predicted lineup. **Manchester City possible starting XI:** Donnarumma; Nunes, Guehi, Dias, Gvardiol; Fernandez, Anderson; Ndiaye, Cherki, Doku; Haaland. ## How to watch Liverpool vs Manchester City?
